title: Sticky Note Manager (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Sticky Note Manager applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Sticky Note Manager (BtnStickyNoteManager) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Delete Sticky Notes removes the marked notes after confirmation in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed sticky-note workflow on two selected text boxes first marks both via the PrefixName action (measured both shapes carry the sticky tag and the StickyNote_ name prefix, countAfterMark=2), then the Delete action shows its YesNo confirmation (the driver measures dialogSeen=True and dismisses with a synthetic key press) and removes both notes (measured countAfterDelete=0 notesRemoved=True), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
